top_posts.text:
ge aerospace $GE total orders are up 48.4% year over year to 19 billion dollars 
 
commercial engines and defense both grew by about the same rate, so the jump is not coming from one side only 
 
the order backlog is still down from a year ago, which looks odd next to orders growing this fast 
 
to me the demand is clearly there, the open question is why the backlog is not growing with it 
 
stron
